summary: Buttons in the loading state, including one that toggles loading for two seconds when clicked.
use: Submit and save buttons that wait on a request and must block repeat clicks while keeping their label.
spec: `loading` on `variant="filled"` and `variant="outlined"` shows the spinner in place of the leading icon
`onclick={save}` sets `saving = true` and resets it with `setTimeout(() => (saving = false), 2000)`
